name: Krabisuchus
isnote: First read as an alligatorine related to Allognathosuchus, later placed in the Orientalosuchina, whose position (alligatoroid or crocodyloid) is disputed.
sum: Krabisuchus is an orientalosuchine crocodylian from the Late Eocene of the Krabi Basin, Thailand.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted. Named by Martin and Lauprasert (2010) from the Krabi Basin.
material: The sources consulted do not list the material.
biology: It has been speculated that it was more terrestrial than modern alligators (English Wikipedia).
author: Martin and Lauprasert 2010

sources.text: J. E. Martin and K. Lauprasert. 2010. A new primitive alligatorine from the Eocene of Thailand: relevance of Asiatic members to the radiation of the group. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 158:608-628
